aj_support: Escalating GALETECH (trial) — customers seeing 500s from embeddings API since 2024-03-18 after a high-volume QA run. Support reproduced locally; appears to be a retry loop combined with stale token handling. Renewal in 12 days and usage is ramping. Need CS to own customer comms and renewal-risk mitigation. Minimal repro and logs below.
aj_support: Logs: ```ERROR embed-service: 500 downstream timeout; retry-after=30s``` and sample request: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"sample"}'```
maria_cs: Ack. Marking as P1 for renewal exposure. @dave_csm can you lead comms? Also loop success-ops for temporary quota/credit play.
dave_csm: I will take lead. Proposed plan: 1) ack email within 1h, 2) send workaround (client-side backoff + token refresh), 3) ETA/update from eng, 4) EBR within 48h if not resolved, 5) propose goodwill credit if impact persists. Who can confirm eng ETA?
zoe_success_ops: I'll coordinate with eng-infra. Please paste incident link + any assigned oncall. I also need a short comms template.
aj_support: oncall-bot linked incident INC-2026-238: <https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-238|INC-2026-238>, assignee=eng-runtime (sre). Patch candidate targeted EOD tomorrow, no hotfix yet.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-238 update: priority=P1, assignee=eng-runtime, status=investigating.
maria_cs: Draft comms (edit as needed): "Hi <Customer Team>, were aware of intermittent embed errors and are actively investigating with engineering. A patch is targeted by EOD tomorrow. Immediate options: enable temporary quota increase and apply client-side exponential backoff. We'll follow up with a root-cause analysis and next steps." :pray:
dave_csm: Draft looks good. I'll send after quota bump is validated. Sending only once we confirm either quota applied or patch ETA slips.
zoe_success_ops: I'll run the quota bump playbook now: checklist = [confirm contact, apply quota via ops console, smoke test, log results]. ETA 2 hours. Will update here when done.
aj_support: Added repro artifacts to incident. Happy to join customer call.
dave_csm: Please include me on eng standups for this incident. I'll own customer updates and any renewal/credit talks.
maria_cs: Opening a renewal-watch doc and tagging finance for pre-approval on pro-rated credit if impact extends. @zoe_success_ops ping when quota bump completes.
zoe_success_ops: Quota bump applied and smoke-tested at 1725124456. Request success rate increased in the quick test. Uploaded ops runbook excerpt to incident.
oncall-bot: ENG update: mitigation identified (retry-loop guard); patch in internal review.
dave_csm: Sending initial ack now. Comms checklist: 1) issue reproduced? yes. 2) quota bump applied? yes. 3) patch ETA still EOD tomorrow? yes. If any change, follow-up note planned.
maria_cs: Thanks team. Keep replies concise here so we can aggregate comms. I'll draft the EBR invite and include impact metrics for credit decision. :thumbsup:
aj_support: Standing by for next steps. Thanks everyone.
